lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Reward: Mouse Pad ×2

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Woooww, I can't believe it!

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: You actually found one!

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: I've heard that they're quite difficult to find.
What do you plan on doing with it?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Oh, that?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: I don't have many friends.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Actually... I don't have any friends.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: But since four-leaf clovers bring you luck,

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: I thought I may be able to use it

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: to try and make a friend, somehow.
You want to have a friend?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Yes... someone I can spend time with

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: or have lunch together.
I can be your friend, then.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: What???
As of this moment, consider us friends.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: For real?

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Wow, this four-leaf clover really does bring good luck!

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Thanks...

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: for being my first friend.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: I'm very lucky to have met you, Commander.

lines.speaker: serial
lines.text: Thank you, truly.
